name: RC22 H1: Loss Rebalancing (IS=0.005, VS=1.0)
theory: IS at lambda=0.05 was 66% of gradient (intended ~10%), starving CRPS and VS. VS at 5% is too weak to prevent attention layers from collapsing noise to rank-1. Rebalanced: CRPS 63%, VS 23%, IS 14%. VS boost should preserve the multi-factor structure the decoder naturally learns at epoch 10 (GT-matched: corr=0.389, eff_rank=2.35) but CRPS destroys by epoch 40.
target: Noise effective rank increases from ~2 to 3+. S2 improves. S9 preserved. Total >= 7/9.
implementation: Two hyperparameter changes on baseline softplus: --lambda_is 0.005 --lambda_vs 1.0. No architecture change.
kill_condition: Noise effective rank at epoch 80 unchanged from baseline (~2 factors). Or S4 kurtosis < 0.5.
if_fails: VS alone cannot counterbalance CRPS rank-1 attractor. Need architectural change (factored FiLM) or freeze-at-peak.

name: RC22 H2: K Reduction (K=8, B=32)
theory: SOTA uses K=2-4. Our K=16 has centering/spread ratio 1.07 (balanced). K=8 gives 1.14 (centering dominant). Each scenario gets stronger individual MAE gradient. B=32 K=8 gives same B*K=256 VRAM.
target: S2 centering improves. Individual scenario quality increases.
if_fails: K is not the bottleneck at our scale.

name: RC22 H3: Factored Condition-Noise FiLM
theory: CLN uses scale(z) not scale(z,cond). Condition doesn't modulate noise amplitude. Factored FiLM: gamma = gamma_cond(cond) * gamma_noise(z). Condition controls amplitude, noise controls pattern.
target: Turb/calm width ratio increases. Condition-dependent spread.
if_fails: The implicit condition-noise interaction through h is sufficient.

name: RC22 H4: Encoder 98/2 Fix (Contrastive, from RC21 H2)
theory: Encoder condition is 98% shared constant. Contrastive loss (InfoNCE) pushes conditions from different regimes apart. More discriminative conditions help all downstream components.
target: Encoder probe accuracy improvement. S7 L2 improvement.
if_fails: Encoder has enough info. Problem is fully downstream.
